summary: A pantry tracker that uses AI to suggest recipes built around the food that is about to expire.
details: My first hackathon, at HackMTY, Mexico's largest student hackathon. I led a team of four to tackle household food waste.
Users register what's in their pantry along with expiration dates. Gemini generates recipes that prioritize ingredients close to expiring, and the app sends reminders before food goes bad.

summary: A finance chatbot that answers customer questions in Atrato's professional, supportive voice.
details: Hackathon hosted by the fintech Atrato. We built Bamboo, a chatbot that answers questions about financial products, services and general financial literacy.
It was a hands-on introduction to the financial sector and to building conversational AI for customer service.

summary: A customer-support dashboard for Hey Banco that surfaces response times and service bottlenecks.
details: My first datathon, hosted by Tec de Monterrey's Data Science Club. We took Hey Banco's challenge to help them respond to customers faster.
We analyzed support data to find patterns and bottlenecks, and built a dashboard showing response times, customer satisfaction and agent performance.

summary: An interactive map that predicts regional electricity consumption with 90% accuracy.
details: Hackathon hosted by Universidad del Norte. We built OLLI, a platform that forecasts upcoming electricity use by region.
Machine learning models trained on historical consumption power an interactive map where users explore predictions by region and time period, helping authorities and residents plan energy use.
